name: chad-review
description: Adversarial pre-merge review for Claude Code. /ultra-audit is the merge gate (with chad-review 3.0.0+): it reviews the whole PR branch through a read-only staged lens, runs the project's gate and tests in your real worktree, deterministic doc, contract, and dependency scans, Opus finders that report everything, and Opus verifiers that refute a finding only with quoted proof (code, command output, the change's stated intent) or as a style preference no rule names, never on a confidence score; a red gate or failing test counts without a ruling. Fast depth (one finder) for small changes, deep depth (per-block finders, a challenger, one gap sweep) for risky, large, prompt, or status-bearing-doc changes; both keep every finding. Findings on the change are fixed in the PR at every severity, pre-existing ones go to one follow-up PR, a persisted ledger supplies the receipt counts, and a GO receipt must record zero open findings. /deps-update takes each dependency to its newest stable release within its current major as its own PR, keeping a manifest's update only on a green gate; ecosystems without an in-range updater are skipped and named. /chad-review remains the explicit 5-pass fan-out with session-relative sonnet/opus reviewers and the same verifier; its pass 5 updates dependencies in place. Not read-only: runs your gate, tests, codegen, and scanner; /ultra-audit applies /simplify and docs-apply edits to your branch and /chad-review rewrites manifests and lockfiles, all left uncommitted; both back up untracked files first.
